title: storage tub with handle lid
text: storage tub with handle lid. I purchased one of these and then came back to purchase 2 more to help store miscellaneous toys my grandsons have... army guys... match boxes... magnetic blocks... etc.  There never seems to be enough space.  These tubs are great because of the handle tops that positively lock on.  So that's good.  Obviously I'm happy as I purchased 2 more and my first purchase!  Perfect size too. Accurate measurements given in ad.
